result.brief: 提出跨模态图Lasso框架，用SigLIP-2特征学习稀疏条件依赖图用于分类与分割，与视频/多模态世界模型及生成潜空间方向无直接关联。
result.reason: Proposes sparse Gaussian graphical model over SigLIP-2 features for classification/segmentation; no video/multimodal world model, generative latent, or representation-learning contribution matching the directions.
